messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Advance Sleep Log Error
parts:
Hi Abdul,

The visualreport is not how you should review the GGIR results as the visualreport does intend to reflect the exact quantitative analysis conducted by GGIR. See documentation on visualreport in https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIRParameters.html and https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html 

To review your results see csv report, e.g. results/QC/part4_nightsummary.csv, which based on the file you shared earlier indicates that the sleeplog is not used for all nights either the sleeplog does not have data or the accelerometer does not provide sufficient wear time.

You may want to first test your code based on a recordings where you know that the accelerometer has sufficiently been worn.

Best wishes,
Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
